Terms.title: Talkinu Terms of Use
Terms.intro: These Terms of Use govern access to and use of Talkinu, an online English-teaching platform that connects students with human teachers for focused speaking sessions. By creating an account or using Talkinu, you agree to these terms. These terms do not currently include a personal-information or privacy section.

agreement.title: 1. Agreement to the terms
agreement.body: You may use Talkinu only if you accept these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, you must not create an account or use the platform. Talkinu may refuse, suspend, or end access when these terms are not followed.

service.title: 2. The Talkinu service
service.body:
Talkinu is a marketplace and classroom platform for English speaking practice. Students can discover approved teachers, book sessions, and receive instructional feedback. Teachers can apply to teach, publish availability after approval, and conduct sessions.

The core product is an exactly 15-minute speaking session between a student and a human teacher. AI tools may analyze sessions and assist teachers, but AI does not replace teachers.

accounts.title: 3. Accounts and usernames
accounts.body:
You must provide accurate account details and keep your login credentials secure. Usernames on Talkinu are exclusive. A username can be used by only one account, and you may not choose a username that is already taken, impersonates Talkinu, impersonates another person, or is reserved by the platform.

You are responsible for activity that happens through your account. Notify Talkinu if you believe your account has been used without permission.

students.title: 4. Student use
students.body:
Students use Talkinu to learn English through live speaking practice. Students must join booked sessions on time, participate respectfully, and use the session for language learning rather than unrelated commercial activity.

Students must not harass teachers, record sessions except where Talkinu expressly provides recording as part of the product, or try to move paid teaching off the platform in order to avoid Talkinu’s rules.

teachers.title: 5. Teacher use
teachers.body:
Selecting the teacher option means you are applying to teach. It does not make you a public teacher. You may appear publicly, publish availability, or receive bookings only after Talkinu approves your application and the required professional profile and introduction video.

Teachers must teach professionally, keep session commitments, and not misrepresent qualifications, availability, or the results a student should expect. Teachers remain responsible for the instruction they provide.

sessions.title: 6. Sessions, scheduling, and cancellation
sessions.body:
Speaking sessions are exactly 15 minutes. A booking is a commitment by both the student and the teacher to attend at the scheduled time. Late arrival, absence, or last-minute cancellation can reduce the value of the session.

Talkinu may set cancellation windows, no-show rules, and scheduling limits to keep the marketplace fair. Do not create overlapping bookings or interfere with another user’s scheduled session.

payments.title: 7. Fees and platform payments
payments.body:
Talkinu may charge students for sessions and related learning services, and may compensate approved teachers through the platform. Prices, teacher earnings, refunds, and payout timing will be shown in the product when those features are available.

You must not request or make payment outside Talkinu in order to avoid platform fees, booking rules, or quality standards. Unauthorized off-platform payment arrangements may lead to account limits or removal.

conduct.title: 8. Community standards
conduct.body:
Talkinu is a professional learning environment. You must treat other users with respect. Harassment, hate, threats, sexual misconduct, discrimination, spam, and any behavior that makes a session unsafe are prohibited.

Do not share lesson materials in a way that violates another person’s rights, and do not use Talkinu to recruit users into unrelated businesses during sessions.

intellectualProperty.title: 9. Intellectual property and platform content
intellectualProperty.body:
Talkinu owns the platform, branding, software, and the content it publishes. Teachers retain rights in their own original teaching materials, and students retain rights in their own original contributions, except for the limited license needed for Talkinu to operate the service, host sessions, and provide instructional feedback.

You may not copy, scrape, reverse engineer, or resell Talkinu, teacher profiles, or session content except as allowed by these terms or by a separate written permission.

prohibitedUse.title: 10. Prohibited uses
prohibitedUse.body:
You may not use Talkinu to break the law, interfere with the service, probe or disrupt our systems, create fake accounts, manipulate reviews or bookings, share account access, or circumvent teacher-approval, scheduling, or payment rules.

Automated access, scraping, and attempts to extract teaching inventory or user lists without permission are forbidden.

termination.title: 11. Suspension and termination
termination.body:
Talkinu may suspend or close an account, hide a teacher profile, cancel sessions, or refuse future use when these terms are violated, when required for safety or operational integrity, or when an application or account is rejected or suspended under Talkinu’s review rules.

You may stop using Talkinu at any time. Ending an account does not cancel obligations that already arose from completed or booked sessions.

disclaimers.title: 12. Educational nature of the service
disclaimers.body:
Talkinu provides language-learning services. It does not guarantee a particular exam score, job outcome, visa result, or fluency timeline. Teachers and AI-assisted feedback are instructional aids, not legal, medical, or immigration advice.

Session quality can vary with internet connection, device quality, and whether both participants attend as scheduled.

liability.title: 13. Limitation of liability
liability.body: To the fullest extent allowed by applicable law, Talkinu is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential losses arising from use of the platform, missed sessions, teacher or student conduct, or service interruptions. Talkinu’s total liability for a claim relating to the service is limited to the amount you paid to Talkinu for the affected service during the three months before the claim, unless applicable law requires otherwise.

changes.title: 14. Changes to these terms
changes.body: Talkinu may update these Terms of Use as the product grows. When changes are material, we will present the updated terms in the product. Continued use of Talkinu after the updated terms take effect means you accept the revised terms.

contact.title: 15. Contact
contact.body: Questions about these Terms of Use can be sent through Talkinu support once support contact details are published in the product. Until then, use the in-product account and application flows to manage your relationship with Talkinu.

TeacherDiscovery.filterEmptyDescription: Clear a filter or load more teachers. Filters apply to the teachers already loaded.
TeacherDiscovery.heroDescription: Watch teacher introductions, get to know their teaching style, and choose the best fit for your next 15-minute speaking session.
TeacherDiscovery.searchSubjectLabel: What do you want to learn?

TeacherAvailability.title: Publish your speaking availability
TeacherAvailability.description: Set the weekly hours students can book, plus one-off changes for specific dates.
TeacherAvailability.loadErrorDescription: Talkinu could not verify your current schedule. No editable state is assumed until a fresh server snapshot is loaded.
TeacherAvailability.lockedDescription: Your current teacher state does not allow availability management. Editing stays disabled until Talkinu confirms that your account is eligible again.
TeacherAvailability.weeklyDescription: Add one or more time windows per day. Changes go live when you save.
TeacherAvailability.replacementNotice: Saving replaces the complete recurring weekly schedule with exactly the windows shown here. Removing every window and saving clears recurring availability.
TeacherAvailability.weeklySaveSuccess: Your recurring weekly schedule was saved and refreshed from Talkinu.
TeacherAvailability.exceptionsTitle: Open or block a specific date
TeacherAvailability.exceptionsDescription: Add an extra opening or block time for a date in the current booking window. These records are stored separately from the recurring schedule.
TeacherAvailability.finishWeeklyFirst: Save or reset your weekly draft before changing one-off exceptions, so a server refresh cannot discard unsaved weekly edits.
TeacherAvailability.notePlaceholder: For example: appointment or extra evening hours
TeacherAvailability.noExceptions: No one-off changes are recorded in this booking window.
TeacherAvailability.exceptionCreateSuccess: The one-off availability change was created and the schedule was refreshed.
TeacherAvailability.exceptionDeleteSuccess: The one-off availability change was deleted and the schedule was refreshed.
TeacherAvailability.precedenceNotice: One-off openings and blocks may overlap. Talkinu calculates final availability on the server; a block wins where one-off rules overlap.

errors.network: Talkinu could not be reached. No schedule change is assumed; try again.
errors.invalidResponse: Talkinu returned an unexpected availability response. No change is assumed; reload the authoritative schedule before continuing.
errors.invalidRequest: The schedule change was rejected. Review the fields and times, then submit the complete desired schedule again.
errors.range: The availability date range was rejected by Talkinu. Reload the editor to request a fresh supported range.
errors.security: Talkinu could not verify this browser mutation as a trusted application request. Reload the app before trying again.
errors.unavailable: This account cannot access teacher availability right now.
errors.exceptionNotFound: That one-off change no longer exists in your current schedule. The authoritative schedule has been refreshed.
errors.conflict: Your availability changed at the same time elsewhere. Talkinu refreshed the authoritative schedule; review it before making another change.
errors.generic: The availability change could not be confirmed. No success is assumed; review the current server state and try again.
errors.refreshFailed: The mutation finished but Talkinu could not refresh the authoritative schedule. Reload before making another availability change.

UpcomingSessions.title: Upcoming sessions
UpcomingSessions.description: Your confirmed speaking schedule, shown in Tehran time.
UpcomingSessions.emptyDescription: When a speaking session is scheduled, it will appear here with its confirmed time and participant.
UpcomingSessions.loadErrorDescription: We could not retrieve your current session list. Try again to see the latest schedule.
UpcomingSessions.loadMoreError: We could not load more sessions. Try again.
UpcomingSessions.cancelStudentDescription: Talkinu will confirm the cancellation before changing this session. If it can no longer be cancelled, the session will stay unchanged.
UpcomingSessions.cancelTeacherDescription: Talkinu will confirm the cancellation before changing this session. Teachers must include a reason.
UpcomingSessions.reasonRequired: Enter a cancellation reason before continuing.
UpcomingSessions.rebookDescription: The cancelled session stays cancelled. Choosing another time starts a separate new booking.
UpcomingSessions.bookAnotherTime: Choose another time with this teacher
UpcomingSessions.invalidSessionData: This session response does not match the expected participant contract. Refresh and try again.

errors.cutoff: This session can no longer be cancelled under the current cancellation policy.
errors.started: This session has already started, so it can no longer be cancelled.
errors.stateChanged: The session state changed before cancellation completed. Refresh the list and review its current state.
errors.conflict: Another session change happened at the same time. Review the current session state and try again if appropriate.
errors.stale: This session is no longer available in its previous state. Refresh your sessions.
errors.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to cancel this session.
errors.invalidRequest: The cancellation request was rejected. Review the information and try again.
errors.network: We could not reach Talkinu. The session is still shown as scheduled; try again.
errors.generic: The session could not be cancelled. Its current schedule remains unchanged.
errors.invalidResponse: Talkinu could not confirm the cancellation result. The session remains unchanged.

StudentBooking.loadingProfile: Loading teacher profile and current slots…
StudentBooking.bioFallback: This teacher has not added a public biography yet.
StudentBooking.authorityTitle: Availability is rechecked when you book
StudentBooking.authorityDescription: These times come directly from Talkinu’s booking service, but another booking or schedule change can make a displayed slot unavailable before confirmation.
StudentBooking.slotsDescription: Select one of the currently projected Tehran-time slots. Your booking exists only after Talkinu confirms a persisted scheduled session.
StudentBooking.slotsLoadErrorTitle: Current slots could not be verified
StudentBooking.slotsLoadErrorDescription: Talkinu could not load the authoritative slot list. Try again before selecting a time.
StudentBooking.noSlotsTitle: No bookable times are available right now
StudentBooking.noSlotsDescription: This teacher has no authoritative opening in the current booking window. Availability can change as schedules and bookings change.
StudentBooking.confirmedDescription: Talkinu confirmed a scheduled session for {time}.
StudentBooking.teacherUnavailableTitle: This teacher is no longer available to book
StudentBooking.teacherUnavailableDescription: The profile may have changed since discovery. Return to the teacher list for a fresh, server-verified option.
StudentBooking.profileLoadErrorTitle: Teacher profile could not be verified
StudentBooking.profileLoadErrorDescription: Talkinu could not load a fresh public profile. Try again before choosing a time.

networkRetry.title: The booking result is not confirmed yet
networkRetry.description: The response was interrupted or could not be verified. Retry the same attempt so Talkinu can safely recover the same durable booking if it already succeeded.

slotUnavailable.title: That time is no longer available
slotUnavailable.description: Talkinu refreshed the authoritative slots. Choose a new time from the updated list.

bookingConflict.title: The schedule changed while you were booking
bookingConflict.description: Talkinu refreshed the authoritative slots after a concurrent booking conflict. Choose a fresh time before trying again.

idempotencyConflict.title: This booking attempt can no longer be reused
idempotencyConflict.description: Talkinu refreshed the authoritative slots. Select a time again to begin a genuinely new booking attempt with a new request key.

limitExceeded.title: You have reached the upcoming-session limit
limitExceeded.description: Talkinu cannot accept another booking for this account right now. Review your upcoming sessions before booking again.

studentIneligible.title: This account cannot book student sessions right now
studentIneligible.description: Your current account state is not eligible for student booking. Talkinu’s server remains the authority for booking access.

selfBooking.title: You cannot book your own teacher profile
selfBooking.description: Choose a different teacher for your speaking session.

authRequired.title: Sign in before confirming a booking
authRequired.description: Teacher profiles and slots are public, but creating a speaking session requires an authenticated active student account.

untrustedOrigin.title: Talkinu could not verify this booking request
untrustedOrigin.description: The secure booking request was rejected. Reload Talkinu from its normal application address before trying again.

invalidRequest.title: This booking selection could not be submitted
invalidRequest.description: The selected request no longer matches the booking contract. Reload the profile and select a fresh authoritative slot.

internalError.title: Talkinu could not confirm the booking result
internalError.description: A server error interrupted confirmation. Retrying the same attempt preserves the same request key and cannot turn it into a different booking.

StudentAiChat.starterOne: How can I practice past tense before my next session?
StudentAiChat.starterTwo: Give me five useful travel phrases for beginners.
StudentAiChat.starterThree: What should I review after making grammar mistakes?
StudentAiChat.footnote: AI assists your study questions. Teachers teach. Session analysis comes from Talkinu’s self-hosted pipeline.
